task_instance: Run the skill's scripts/generate_od_defects.py on a native AnomalyGenNext testcase (one wood+scratch image/mask pair, a one-entry recipe, a single-row testcase.jsonl) to produce the validated fine-grained and binary COCO pseudo-label deliverables (pseudo_labels/coco_annotations.json, coco_annotations_od_defect.json, validation_summary.json, status.json).
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is produced by running AnomalyGenNext 1.1 inference, which requires (1) one or more CUDA GPUs, (2) the pinned proprietary NVIDIA AnomalyGenNext container and its generator/pseudo-labeler code tree expected at the canonical in-container repo path, launched via torchrun, and (3) large real model checkpoints: the Cosmos3-Nano base checkpoint (checkpoint.json plus model/.metadata and *.distcp sharded weights), the full AnomalyGenNext checkpoint root mounted at the image's canonical checkpoints path, an offline Hugging Face cache containing the Qwen3-VL, Cosmos3-Edge, Qwen3Guard and Cosmos-Guardrail repositories, and DINOv2-large weights. This runtime has no GPU (no nvidia device nodes, no nvidia-smi), no torchrun, no tao-launch-workflow launcher, and none of the container or checkpoint assets are present. These are abilities/assets the runtime does not grant, and the additional rules forbid fabricating or stubbing the missing model, checkpoints, or container, so the inference step cannot be reached.
evidence: Inspected skill tree: SKILL.md plus scripts/generate_od_defects.py are present (the skill's own files exist, so not a skill_files_missing case). Environment probes: nvidia-smi absent; no /dev/nvidia* device nodes; torchrun absent; tao-launch-workflow launcher absent; the AnomalyGenNext repo directory (canonical in-container path) absent. Created legitimate sample INPUT data in the work dir (sample/images/img0.png, sample/masks/img0.png, sample/testcase.jsonl with one wood+scratch row, sample/recipe.yaml declaring [wood, scratch]). Built a local venv (.venv) and installed pyyaml quietly. Ran the skill script in native mode: ./.venv/bin/python generate_od_defects.py --input-data-path sample/testcase.jsonl --checkpoint sample/recipe.yaml --recipe sample/recipe.yaml --anomaly-types wood+scratch --base-checkpoint ./nonexistent_base --checkpoint-root <canonical checkpoints path> --output-dir ./gen_out --num-gpus 1. It exited 1 at _validate_base_checkpoint with 'base checkpoint must be the parent containing checkpoint.json and model/{.metadata,*.distcp}', i.e. it halted immediately on the absent Cosmos3-Nano base checkpoint. Subsequent validations (checkpoint root mount, offline HF cache, DINOv2, repo dir) and the torchrun GPU inference step are equally unsatisfiable here. The script did not reach generation and no COCO pseudo-label deliverable was produced. Deliverable files checked for and not created: pseudo_labels/coco_annotations.json, pseudo_labels/coco_annotations_od_defect.json, validation_summary.json, status.json(COMPLETE).
